Notes_and_Tips: Prefer whole grains and include fiber-rich dals for satiety.
Limit fried and sugary foods; choose fruit or nuts when craving sweets.
Aim for gentle daily walks to support energy and stress reduction.
Plan simple meals ahead for busy field work days.
Stay hydrated and prioritize consistent meal times.
Keep portion sizes moderate; use smaller plates if helpful.
